questions.question: Implement the Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache.
questions.answer: Implementing an LRU Cache involves storing key-value pairs with eviction of the least recently used item when capacity is exceeded.Use a hash map for O(1) access to cache items.Use a doubly linked list to maintain the order of usage.On access, move the accessed item to the front of the list.On insertion, if the cache exceeds capacity, remove the tail of the list.Example: For a cache of capacity 2, accessing keys 1, 2, then 1 again, will keep 1 and 2 in cache.
